header: You invite, they join, both sides get something
lead: Two to four steps in an ordered list, with the reward named in the lead rather than left to be worked out from the steps.
note: Conditions belong on a linked page, not in this note: a programme whose small print outgrows its explanation has stopped being an invitation.

steps.title: First step
steps.text: The tile carries the number as type, and the ordered list carries the order for anybody who cannot see the tile.

steps.title: Second step
steps.text: Cards stretch to the height of the tallest in the row, so no step looks like the short and therefore easy one.

steps.title: Third step
steps.text: Four is the ceiling. A process that needs a fifth panel is a page, not a band.
